about: Gemma 4 26B-A4B on the uniform K4 EXL3 pack (exllamav3 1.6.5, mul1 codebook, L338): every Linear -- attention q / k / v / o, the dense GeGLU MLP and the routed experts (split gate / up per expert) -- exl3m_k4, and the head exllamav3 quantized from the tied embedding exl3m_k6 (the Turing build runs it: the BF16 head GEMM needs sm_80+), byte copies of the pack (--exl3), the MLP and experts at the pack's stored widths (2176, 768); norms, the router and its scales, the per-layer scalar and the embedding (lookups) from the BF16 checkpoint (--hf) as stored. The vision tower is consumed by name (v1: text only). Plus the JEV adapter (--adapter jev): its LoRA pairs f16 (the runtime LoRA's tensor-core operand, L338) and its decision head as stored (F32), for the runtime LoRA (L338 P2). Plus z-lab's DFlash block drafter (--drafter dflash, L338 P3): its Linears f16 from BF16 (the Turing lane's dense format: bf16 tensor cores are sm_80+), its norms as stored; it reads the target's embedding and EXL3 head.
